title: Particle Pins Collectables Prices (Domain Generator)
style: playful electro swing, 128 bpm, 336 hz subharmonic, dictionary-shuffle vocal stabs, slot-machine bell, kazoo bass, mock-corporate jingle outro
lyrics:
[Intro]
three words and a dash, three words and a dash
your subdomain just rolled the trash

[Verse 1]
particle, pins, collectables, prices
sounds like a flea market crisis
cloudflare picks them out the hat
you get whatever, that is that

[Pre-Chorus]
adjective, noun, plural, plural
random name, totally neutral

[Chorus]
particle pins collectables prices
spinning the wheel of dictionary dices
tomorrow it's mango, banjo, lanterns, lakes
whatever the random generator makes

[Verse 2]
doesn't matter what the words say
the tunnel only lives a day
you could call it grandma's barn
still goes dark when you stop the yarn

[Chorus]
particle pins collectables prices
spinning the wheel of dictionary dices
tomorrow it's mango, banjo, lanterns, lakes
whatever the random generator makes

[Outro]
buy a real domain, ten bucks a year
or laugh at the words while they disappear
